name: chystyi-dev
comment:overrides: Next 15.5.22 vendors its own postcss (8.4.31) and sharp (0.34.5), both flagged high by npm audit. npm's only offered fix is Next 16, a breaking major. Neither CVE class is reachable here — postcss only ever parses our own globals.css at build time, and sharp is dead weight because the site uses no next/image (the OG routes render through next/og, not sharp). These pins are minor-version bumps that clear the advisories without the major upgrade; drop them when moving to Next 16.
